text: Car crashes. Fatal diseases. Even old age.
Then they discover the terrible truth.
Nobody dies, but millions of babies are still born.
Cities overflow. Food disappears. Fresh water becomes priceless.
But there is one problem nobody can solve.
People fight for food. Nations fall.
But it has created a world where nobody can escape.
The oceans boil. The atmosphere vanishes.
Earth becomes a lifeless, burning rock.
And every person is still alive.
No food. No water. No escape.
And humanity faces an eternity it can never end.
We never asked what forever would feel like.
